content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Trenton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and professional experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates need a combination of formal project-management education and documented hours leading projects. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications and clarify any gaps before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend sessions at times that fit your Trenton-area work schedule, engage with experienced instructors in real time, and earn the 35 contact hours PMI requires before exam eligibility. Course materials and recordings support your study plan.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Log into your PMI account, complete the PMP application form, and document your project-management experience and education. Pay the exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy's team can guide you through each field to ensure accuracy and avoid delays in PMI's review.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center convenient to Trenton. On exam day, you'll answer questions covering the PMBOK Guide framework, industry best practices, and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, sustain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses, webinars, and community-engagement activities that count toward renewal. Plan your PDU strategy early to stay current without last-minute pressure.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
